name: barbell pause decline bench press
description: Decline bench press with a stop on your chest. The pause removes bounce and builds strength out of the bottom.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest.
Hold the bar still on your chest for a full second.
Press the bar up powerfully until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet secured and shoulder blades tight.
